# NEW 2026-11-21 v9.7 Route 3A: Great Yuan Core Line 2.0 Refinement (oe_yr2_, 0 slots). Generated by gen_yuan_v97.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# 1. Grant Tou-Xia Annual Stipend & Tiger Tally (赐投下岁赐与虎符)
oe_yr2_grant_touxia_charter = {
    type = subject
    category = CATEGORY_SUBJECT_ACTIONS
    use_enroute = no
    ai_tick = monthly
    ai_tick_frequency = 24
    ai_prerequisite = {
        oe_yr2_yuan_active = yes
        any_subject = { oe_yr2_touxia_target = yes }
    }
    potential = {
        scope:actor = {
            oe_yr2_yuan_active = yes
            any_subject = { oe_yr2_touxia_target = yes }
        }
    }
    allow = {
        scope:actor = {
            is_subject = no
            gold >= 120
        }
    }
    select_trigger = {
        looking_for_a = country
        interaction_source_list = {
            scope:actor = {
                every_subject = {
                    limit = { oe_yr2_touxia_target = yes }
                    add_to_list = source
                }
            }
        }
        target_flag = recipient
        name = "choose_country"
        default_sort = will
        column = { data = country_diplomacy_info_subject }
        visible = {
            oe_yr2_touxia_target = yes
        }
        enabled = {
            custom_tooltip = {
                text = oe_yr2_grant_cd_tt
                NOT = { has_cooldown = oe_yr2_grant_touxia_cd }
            }
        }
    }
    effect = {
        if = {
            limit = { exists = scope:recipient }
            scope:actor = {
                add_gold = -120
                add_prestige = 3
            }
            scope:recipient = {
                add_gold = 120
                add_liberty_desire = -15
                add_opinion = { target = scope:actor modifier = oe_yr2_b_touxia_charter }
                add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_yr2_touxia_tiger_tally years = 10 mode = replace }
                add_cooldown = { type = oe_yr2_grant_touxia_cd years = 10 }
                if = {
                    limit = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes }
                    oe_yw_change_loyalty = { amount = 15 }
                }
                if = {
                    limit = { tag = YLY }
                    oe_yp_change_loyalty = { unit = 9 amount = 12 }
                }
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        tag = CKO
                        situation:red_turban_rebellions = { situation_is_active = yes }
                    }
                    rtr_change_allegiance_points = { value = 15 }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    ai_will_do = {
        value = -35
        if = {
            limit = {
                scope:actor = { gold >= 400 }
                scope:recipient ?= {
                    OR = {
                        liberty_desire >= 40
                        AND = { has_variable = oe_yw_loy var:oe_yw_loy < 45 }
                    }
                }
            }
            add = 55
        }
    }
}

# 2. Dispatch Imperial Censors to Audit Tou-Xia Household Rolls (遣御史核检投下户籍)
oe_yr2_curtail_touxia_audit = {
    type = subject
    category = CATEGORY_SUBJECT_ACTIONS
    use_enroute = no
    ai_tick = monthly
    ai_tick_frequency = 24
    ai_prerequisite = {
        oe_yr2_yuan_active = yes
        any_subject = { oe_yr2_touxia_target = yes }
    }
    potential = {
        scope:actor = {
            oe_yr2_yuan_active = yes
            any_subject = { oe_yr2_touxia_target = yes }
        }
    }
    allow = {
        scope:actor = {
            is_subject = no
            OR = {
                at_war = no
                oe_yr2_restoration_stage1 = yes
            }
            prestige >= 10
            stability >= 0
        }
    }
    select_trigger = {
        looking_for_a = country
        interaction_source_list = {
            scope:actor = {
                every_subject = {
                    limit = { oe_yr2_touxia_target = yes }
                    add_to_list = source
                }
            }
        }
        target_flag = recipient
        name = "choose_country"
        default_sort = will
        column = { data = country_diplomacy_info_subject }
        visible = {
            oe_yr2_touxia_target = yes
        }
        enabled = {
            custom_tooltip = {
                text = oe_yr2_curtail_cd_tt
                NOT = { has_cooldown = oe_yr2_curtail_touxia_cd }
            }
        }
    }
    effect = {
        if = {
            limit = { exists = scope:recipient }
            scope:actor = {
                add_prestige = -10
                add_stability = -3
                add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_yr2_curtailed_touxia_fisc years = 12 mode = replace }
            }
            scope:recipient = {
                add_liberty_desire = 12
                add_opinion = { target = scope:actor modifier = oe_yr2_b_touxia_audit }
                add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_yr2_touxia_curtailed years = 15 mode = replace }
                add_cooldown = { type = oe_yr2_curtail_touxia_cd years = 12 }
                if = {
                    limit = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes }
                    oe_yw_change_loyalty = { amount = -12 }
                }
                if = {
                    limit = { tag = YLY }
                    oe_yp_change_loyalty = { unit = 9 amount = -10 }
                }
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        tag = CKO
                        situation:red_turban_rebellions = { situation_is_active = yes }
                    }
                    rtr_change_allegiance_points = { value = -10 }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    ai_will_do = {
        value = -40
        if = {
            limit = {
                scope:actor = {
                    at_war = no
                    stability >= 15
                    prestige >= 30
                }
                scope:recipient ?= {
                    liberty_desire < 30
                    NOT = { has_country_modifier = oe_yr2_touxia_curtailed }
                }
            }
            add = 50
        }
    }
}
